headline: Latin American Steel Stocks Fall to Six-Month Lows Amid Wall Street Slump
summary: Steel stocks hit a six-month low as Wall Street declined, with Ternium shares falling 5.37 percent and Gerdau dropping 4.57 percent.
why: Ternium and Gerdau are major regional steel producers whose valuations correlate with industrial demand cycles and broader equity market trends.

impacts.name: Ternium SA
impacts.why: Ternium stock fell amid a broader Wall Street equity slump and regional steel sector weakness.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Steel stocks declined as part of a wider Wall Street sell-off that pushed regional industrial equities to six-month lows.
